name: Warm ragi malt in 5 minutes
steps: Mix the ragi malt with 3 to 4 tbsp cold water into a smooth paste.
Boil the milk or water and add the paste while stirring.
Cook on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring all the time.
Add jaggery, stir well and serve warm.

name: Andhra style potato fry
steps: Heat the oil and add mustard, cumin and curry leaves.
Add potatoes, turmeric and salt. Cover and cook till soft.
Add the chilli powder and fry on medium heat till crisp.
Serve hot with rice and dal.

name: Soft rava idli for breakfast
ingredients: Curd and water, as given on the pack
steps: Mix the rava idli mix with curd and water as given on the pack.
Rest the batter for about 10 minutes.
Grease the idli plates and pour in the batter.
Steam for 10 to 12 minutes and serve with chutney.

name: Cinnamon masala chai
ingredients: 1 cup water and ½ cup milk
1 tsp tea leaves, sugar to taste
steps: Boil the water with the cinnamon and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add the tea leaves and boil for 1 more minute.
Add milk and sugar and bring to a boil.
Strain and serve hot.

name: Millet upma in 3 minutes
ingredients: Water, as given on the pack
steps: Boil the water as given on the pack.
Add the upma mix slowly while stirring.
Cover and cook on low heat for about 3 minutes.
Add lemon juice and coriander and serve.

name: Simple tadka for dal
ingredients: ½ tsp mustard and cumin seeds
Curry leaves and a pinch of hing
steps: Heat the groundnut oil in a small pan.
Add mustard and cumin and let them splutter.
Add garlic, red chillies, curry leaves and hing.
Pour over hot dal and cover for a minute.
